data_gaps: Prices, yields and costs are fixed K-State 2027 planning budgets (SW Kansas); their prices are 20-60 % above USDA NASS 2025 Kansas prices and price risk is not in the intervals.

Single soil bucket, no runoff; water use is irrigation need, not metered pumping.
Ogallala aquifer saturated thickness / well capacity and water-right limits (Kansas WIMAS) not considered.
